content: मद्गुः [मस्ज्-उ न्यङ्क्वा˚; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Uṇ. 1. 7</ls>] .²1 A kind of aquatic bird, a cormorant or diver; मांसं गृध्रो वपां मद्गुः (भवति) <ls>Ms. 12. 63</ls>. .²2 A kind of snake. .²3 A kind of wild animal. .²4 A kind of galley or vessel of war; कोऽपि मद्गुरभ्यधावत् <ls>Dk.</ls> .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a degraded mixed tribe, the offspring of a Brāhmaṇa by a woman of the bard class; see <ls>Ms. 10. 48</ls>. .²6 An outcast.
